title: INIT ioctl EOPNOTSUPP returns hard failure not CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE
description: Device returns EOPNOTSUPP on CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_INIT (algo not supported) → crypto2dev_to_wc_err returns NOT_COMPILED_IN → returned to wolfSSL as hard failure. wolfSSL treats any non-zero non-CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE return as an error. The comment in crypto2dev_to_wc_err says caller should return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE for NOT_COMPILED_IN, but no caller does the promotion. Affects cipher (port.c:665), hash (port.c:879-884), and hmac (port.c:1053-1055) INIT paths. Trigger: device that lacks the requested algo. Bad behavior: TLS handshake fails with NOT_COMPILED_IN instead of falling back to software AES/HMAC.
